prompt: Single continuous shot, no cuts. Opens mid-action: a spoon cracking through the surface of a thick golden turmeric soup, steam bursting upward backlit. The camera glides over a board of jewel colors — beet being sliced into deep magenta rounds, avocado halved and twisted open, pomegranate seeds spilling like rubies. Money shot: a yogurt bowl drizzled with honey in a slow spiral, granola and berries falling onto it in slow motion, every texture in macro. Final beat: the table set with the glowing bowls, a hand reaching in. Warm side light, deep shadows, saturated jewel tones against muted wood, film grain. Dominant sound: the spoon crack, then the seeds spilling. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
